message.content: An editorial illustration shows a black-and-white photograph of an elderly man set against a white background with gold and black text. The man, seen from the chest up, has short gray hair, thin-rimmed black glasses, and wears a dark academic robe with wide, light-colored lapels over a collared shirt and dark tie. He holds a white ceramic teacup to his lips with his right hand and balances a matching saucer in his left hand. The lighting creates a dark, defined shadow on the wall behind him. At the top, the large gold word “TEMPO” is positioned next to a small “55.” A gold horizontal block sits above the text. To the left, black text reads “EDISI KHUSUS” above the bold title “Ekonom Pemberontak.” Below this, smaller text reads: “Sumitro Djojohadikusumo meletakkan dasar-dasar ekonomi setelah kemerdekaan. Kebijakan Prabowo Subianto bertolak belakang dengan gagasan ayahnya itu. H.24”. At the bottom left, text lists “1-7 JUN 2026,” “RP 60.000,” and several website and magazine details above a barcode and QR code.
